module: Flowgraph node "Get Drag Racer Data" (category repeat_instant, LEGACY). Convenience node that gives the state of a driver (vehId): isPlayable, lane, isDesqualified, desqualifiedReason, isFinished. The code recommends "Get Drag Racer Status" and "Get Drag Racer Spawn Point" instead.
notes: Writes the outputs only if they are used (isUsed).
If the data is not ready, the outputs keep their previous value.
The spelling "desqualified" (without i) is the game's.

work.desc: Reads dragBridge.getData and getRacerData(vehId), then feeds the used pins.
